About

Event draftsperson and designer with 4+ years delivering large-scale event environments across the MENA region. I specialise in accurate 3D venue models, technical drawings, and build-ready documentation for complex productions, including music festivals, large corporate conferences, exhibitions, theatre productions, and multimedia shows.

My civil engineering background, combined with deep production knowledge, gives me a structurally sound, architecturally precise approach. I'm passionate about transforming creative concepts into technically feasible, safe, and visually striking environments.
